authoring: Object Blueprints, Event Sheets and inherited Rhai callbacks

actions.action: Select Authored Scout and inspect Object ownership; open its blueprint and inherited callback author.
actions.expected: The child points to Enemy Family, move_speed is authored 9 against prefab default 6, and collision/task authors are Enemy Family.rhai.

actions.action: Play and move the blue mouse-controlled block into an orange scout.
actions.expected: A physical collision changes the inherited collision_count and logs FAMILY_COLLISION.

actions.action: Pause after 0.2 seconds and inspect a spawned scout.
actions.expected: Runtime origin is runtime-spawned; primary and inherited behaviors have separate properties, and FAMILY_TASK confirms the named task fired.

actions.action: Resume and knock all eight orange scouts outside the camera.
actions.expected: Score reaches 8 / 8, the completion banner appears and active pooled instances return to zero.

actions.action: Click Restart wave (or press R), inspect Game Manager pool statistics, and repeat a collision.
actions.expected: Eight scouts reappear from the same pool; allocated capacity remains eight, reused count increases and fresh behavior instances receive callbacks.

actions.action: Pause, edit Scout Enemy.rhai move_speed logic, save a valid candidate, then attempt malformed source.
actions.expected: Valid paused reload changes only committed behavior; malformed save leaves the old VM, values and dirty source intact.

actions.action: Stop, change an instance property, Undo/Redo, save the project, reopen and play again.
actions.expected: Blueprint/Event Sheet identities, the authored override, UI restart and pool configuration survive reopening.
